page.layout: One page of text. Above the text, two coin medallions side by side, each with its legend around the rim (left: CÔNENVS and ISAACIVS; right: DVCAS and CONSTANTINVS). Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. Running head centred at top; page number top right. No marginal notes, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: CÔNENVS[?] ISAACIVS DVCAS CONSTANTINVS
ISAACIVS Comnenus post Michaëlem seniorem im-
perat Constantinopoli, anno mundi 5020. à Christo nato 1058.
Hic Michaëlem Seniorem in ordinem redegit: fuit tamen vir
alioqui strenuus, pace ac bello clarus, ac infractus[?], moribusque
arrogantioribus. Cooperante Patriarcha Imperium sumpsit, in
quem tamen postea ingratus, ac velut collati beneficij imme-
mor, ipsum cum suis in exilium misit. Comnena hic gente no-
bili ortus, in negociis obeundis expeditus fuit. Cæterum la-
teris morbo inter venandum subito correptus, cum de salu-
te desperat, cucullam induit, atque imperio se abdicat. Con-
stantinus Ducas de Senatus populíque consensu ei successor
declaratur. Tanta continentia fuisse perhibetur Isaacius, uti
nec uxorem cognoscere vellet post prolem semel ex ea suscep-
tam, cùm tamen ad morbi subleuationē medici in primis con-
sulerent ut coitu uteretur frequentiore. Imperauit annos 4.
Vide Egna.lib.2.
CONSTANTINVS Ducas Constantinopoli imperat
post Isaacium, anno mundi 5024. à Christo nato 1062. hunc
conspiratio sub initia grauis excepit, quam non sine discrimi-
ne compressit: pietatem coluit, æquitatem obseruauit: sed
auaricię supra modum operam dedit, hinc suis odiosus, hosti-
bus etiam ludibrio, res imperij undique vexantibus, fuit. Ad
externa mala familiaris Constantinopoli clades accessit, nem-
pe grauis terræ motus, quo templa, ædésq; multæ pessum ïere.
Obiitsexagenarius, anno imperij sexto, Eudociæ uxori & libe-
ris tribus imperium tradens. Vide ut supra,& Chron.Phry.

page.notes: Coin legends on the medallions are read from the scan and partly curved; the left one (CÔNENVS) is uncertain and may be COMNENVS, so it is marked. "infractus" has a mark over the c that is hard to read. "ïere" is printed with a diaeresis over the i. "Obiitsexagenarius" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s, and u/v to the vowel/consonant form. No marginal notes.
